name: Suwa (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Suwa city emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised bird with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Suwa, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 10 August 1941.

features.role: Suwa city emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised bird with a disc
